form: A narrow woodland path of beaten earth running about 40 m through mixed English woodland between the Duchess's clearing and the March Hare's house, passing under two trees with low horizontal boughs where the Cheshire Cat sits. No built structure
culture_ref: geography.json#LOC-thick-wood (visual_identifiers: low bough where the Cat sits); world.json#wonderland_real_counterparts cp-cat
period: Dream-space grown from an 1862 Oxfordshire copse and a family garden tree; no man-made objects except the old signpost

grows_from.waking_detail: Dinah watching from a garden bough near the family house
grows_from.design_growth: The low apple bough in the family garden where Dinah likes to sit, repeated twice along a wood path and grown into two great old trees: the first an ancient crab-apple with a low, almost horizontal limb at a child's head height, the second an old oak further on whose branch overhangs the path at the fork

dream_design_language: The wood arranged like a stage: the path is swept clean, the two boughs sit exactly where the eye goes, and the background trunks rise in soft, even ranks that curve gently together overhead like the flowing ribs of an Art Nouveau arcade, so the Cat's appearances read as entrances

mucha_design_language.item: Mucha / Art Nouveau language carried by the living wood: each bough the Cat uses is backed by a round gap in the canopy that frames the sitter as a halo roundel; ivy and honeysuckle hang from the boughs in long whiplash tendrils and garland loops; the path edge is a flowing S-curve bordered with foxgloves and dog-roses like a Mucha floral frame; the fingerpost arms are carved as tapering vine-scroll whiplash forms; pastel-and-gold palette (sage, lilac, cream, dappled gold)
mucha_design_language.why: WR-010 dream environments carry the language fully, realised as living and sculpted flora and carved wood; no building is added to the text's woodland path

structure.item: a single-file beaten-earth path about 1.2 m wide, gently curving, with leaf litter at its edges; enters from the Duchess's clearing at one end

Tree A, 'a few yards off' from where Alice sets the pig down: an old crab-apple with a thick low limb running out almost level at about 1.8 m above the path, broad enough for the CGI Cat to lie along it
structure.note: species and height inferred from the waking garden bough, culture_ref world.json cp-cat

structure.item: a fork in the path about 25 m on from Tree A: one branch toward the Hatter, one toward the March Hare
structure.note: the Cat's directions: 'In that direction lives a Hatter: and in that direction lives a March Hare'; fork inferred as the physical form of the directions

structure.item: Tree B at the fork: an old oak with a horizontal branch overhanging the path at about 2.4 m, where the Cat reappears and finally vanishes to a grin
structure.note: reappearance on a branch and the slow vanish (ch006-p78); species inferred

structure.item: background: straight grey trunks of beech and ash in loose ranks, undergrowth of bracken and bramble at knee height
structure.why: Plain woodland depth with a clean silhouette behind the Cat

materials.item: packed brown earth with last year's leaf litter at the edges
crab-apple bark, dark grey and scaly, the limb's upper surface worn smooth
materials.why: A favourite sitting place worn smooth, as a cat's bough would be

materials.item: oak bark grey and furrowed, ivy climbing the trunk of Tree B
materials.why: Ivy gives the second tree a distinct silhouette from the first

details.item: at the fork, a leaning weathered wooden fingerpost with two arms, the painted lettering long faded to nothing
details.why: Grows from the country fingerposts on family walks; blank arms make 'it doesn't much matter which way you go' visible without text

details.item: where Alice sets the pig down and it trots off into the wood: the pig-baby end state is proposed as a photoreal CGI piglet (pending_H2; SUP-006 transition itself unchanged); leaf-litter gap under Tree A left clear for its exit
details.note: BIB-0027 non-speaking dream animals, flagged for H2

details.item: small hard green crab-apples on Tree A
details.why: Midsummer fruit stage; identifies the tree as an apple

details.item: the bough areas left plain and uncluttered, with no leaves in front of the sitter, so the Cat's slow vanish reads cleanly against sky and background trunks

scale_notes.rule: True 1:1 set. Alice at her usual height (135 cm, after the Duchess's kitchen). The first bough's height of 1.8 m puts the CGI Cat's face (a photoreal cat, SUP-002 as amended BIB-0027; light doubling of Dinah) just above Alice's eye line, so she looks up at the grin. The vanish is a dream dissolve (SUP-005): both boughs must be buildable as locked-off plates, empty and with a stand-in/reference object for the CGI cat's contact and shadow

negative: no gnarled horror-fantasy trees (curves are smooth and flowing), no glowing eyes in the dark, no neon or striped foliage
no giant mushrooms, no oversized flowers
no cartoon cat, no oversized cartoon grin graphic, no human in cat costume; the Cat is a photoreal CGI cat
no flat poster illustration, outline graphics or matte-painting finish; photographed live-action wood
no legible signpost text, no modern waymarkers or fences
no dark gothic horror forest; the wood is shaded but friendly midsummer woodland
prompt_ready_en: a narrow beaten-earth path curving through a shaded midsummer English wood, grey beech trunks rising in soft ranks that curve together overhead like an Art Nouveau arcade, an old crab-apple tree with a thick low horizontal bough framed by a round halo-like gap in the canopy, ivy and honeysuckle hanging in long whiplash tendrils, further on an ivy-clad oak with a branch overhanging a fork in the path, a leaning weathered wooden fingerpost with blank vine-scroll carved arms at the fork, foxgloves and dog-roses bordering the path, soft pastel-and-gold light, photographed live-action set
